text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Run, keep running.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Faster than anyone. Truer to myself than 
anyone."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Not for anyone else, but for myself—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess finishes first! Kawakami 
Princess takes first place!!
(Woooooaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what a goofy face! Scarlet, are you 
perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Did you think you were the only one worthy 
of being queen?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hit the bullseye? Ahaha, what's that 
about?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You're not with me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yet today, she could not win. Kawakami 
became the queen.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —That is why I won't lose next time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose to our upperclassmen either. 
Someday, I'll definitely overtake them.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I really wanted Daiwa Scarlet to 
win~. It would've been better if...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, Kawakami's running was amazing too, 
wasn't it? Like, super powerful, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess-san! Please share your 
thoughts on today's race!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
She defeated Daiwa Scarlet-san, who 
entered the race for Vodka-san's sake, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Both she and I are running for our own 
sakes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please do make sure not to mistake that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: !! M-My apologies!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No. And I want to thank all the fans who 
came out to watch today's race.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Thank you for everything up until now.

text_block_list.name: Tanned Boy
text_block_list.text:
"P-Princess!? When you said 'until now'... 
you're not retiring, are you...?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh, retire!? Me!?
choice_data_list: You don't intend to do it, right?

You're not planning on doing that, are 
you?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Of course! Because my battle is—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"‘A princess unfitting of the historic and 
dignified Queen Elizabeth II Cup race 
itself—’"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, I want to become the princess of 
my own ideals.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The battle to continually demonstrate what 
it means to be my kind of princess is far 
from over.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—I would be delighted if, in someone's 
future someday, my footsteps serve as a 
path to follow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
“Even if I can't see, though, I will still 
run for my own sake.”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just as someone's idea of a princess 
differs from mine, it's only natural that 
some still won't accept me as one.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this is what defines me as a 
princess. This is my path, and I will not 
compromise.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is my princesshood—mine alone, one I 
can take pride in being myself, uniquely 
my own.
